answer: Count voting weight only from inbound settlements that form a trellis of already-established, pairwise-unclustered counterparties. Each qualifying payment vests only after a cooling lagoon of K epochs; self-sends and kin-linked hops are ignored. A new name therefore has no power until those independent payers arrive and mature. Standing up a thousand sockpuppets means buying a thousand such inbound paths and waiting out the lagoon on every one; if a later detector merges the cluster, each path's locked marble of escrow is slashed, so every fake head carries a delayed, forfeitable cost.
